research.facts:
Mikrdoo Children's Pajamas CPSC Safety Warning
**Key Facts:**
- Alert type: [HIGH] CPSC Safety Warning (NOT a formal recall — important distinction)
- Brand: [HIGH] Mikrdoo children's pajamas
- Sold via: [HIGH] Amazon.com, August 2025 through May 2026
- Seller: [HIGH] SHEIN as third-party seller on Amazon
- Price: [HIGH] $18–$20
- Violation: [HIGH] fails to meet federal flammability standard for children's sleepwear (16 CFR Part 1615/1616)
- Hazard: [HIGH] burn injury risk
- Recommended action: [HIGH] stop using immediately; do NOT donate; destroy the pajamas
- Timely hook: [HIGH] back-to-school shopping season begins July–August; families replacing old sleepwear
- CPSC page: cpsc.gov (safety warning section)
**Sources:** CPSC.gov safety warning database
**Flags:** Safety Warning vs. Recall distinction must be clear in article. "Destroy" language is direct from CPSC guidance — use it. No injuries reported in the warning — do not invent injury data.
